workstreams.label: Classical Lyric & Character
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Differentiate character pieces by phrase, cadence, meter and motif.

workstreams.label: Baroque and Early Dance Forms
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Represent dance-specific pickups, gait, phrase pairing, reprises and suite order.

workstreams.label: Developmental and Large Forms
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Use form obligations and transitions for rondo, variations, scherzo and concerto.

workstreams.label: Contrapuntal and Polyphonic
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Separate subject entry, imitation, voice independence and closure by form.

workstreams.label: Ground, Ostinato and Transformation
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Separate invariant ground/cell from upper-voice transformation.

workstreams.label: Song and Narrative
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Separate strophic, verse-chorus, through-composed, art-song and work-song.

workstreams.label: Blues, Gospel and Soul
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Separate blues response, gospel escalation, soul build, R&B groove and Neo-Soul pocket.

workstreams.label: Jazz and Improvisatory Forms
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Separate swing, bebop, cool/hard bop, modal vamp, jazz waltz and open form.

workstreams.label: Latin and Caribbean Cycles
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Distinct cycle/accent roles for son, salsa, mambo, cha-cha, samba and bossa nova.

workstreams.label: European and North Atlantic Folk
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Separate regional meter, strain, tune-set and ornament.

workstreams.label: Mediterranean, Middle Eastern and North African Modal
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Keep Fado, maqam, makam, dastgah, nuba, taqsim and rebetiko separate.

workstreams.label: South Asian Raga and Tala
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Keep Hindustani, Dhrupad, Carnatic, RTP, bhajan, ghazal and qawwali distinct.

workstreams.label: East and Southeast Asian Traditions
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Separate Gagaku, honkyoku, min'yo, guqin, sizhu, Gugak, Gamelan and Piphat.

workstreams.label: African and Diasporic Groove
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Separate Afrobeat, Highlife, Juju, Soukous, Amapiano, Gqom, Reggae and Dub.

workstreams.label: Minimal, Process and Experimental
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Expose rules for phase, additive process, spectral change, chance forms and cellular generation.

workstreams.label: Ambient and Electronic Texture
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Separate drone, sequencer, metric mutation, glitch, loop and acoustic/electronic processes.

workstreams.label: Club and Beat Music
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Separate house, techno, trance, DnB, garage, breakbeat and hip-hop by groove and transition.

workstreams.label: Pop and Rock
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Differentiate verse/chorus, bridge, riff, dream pop, synthpop and post-rock arcs.

workstreams.label: Dramatic, Screen and Stage
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Tie scene, character, threat, world state and game state to musical obligations.

workstreams.label: Southern African Urban, Folk and Dance Traditions
workstreams.implementation_hypothesis: Kwaito, Maskandi, Isicathamiya, Mbaqanga, Kwela, Marabi, Township Jazz and Bubblegum Pop need separate sourced definitions and review.
